note: Boot with INITIAL_MODE 0 (STABILIZE), ARMING_SKIPCHK -1, no RC, no ground station; two ticks at rest (estimate level at the origin, healthy; mixer SHUT_DOWN). Worked out from the code, the order is the fast-task order of Copter.cpp:115-142. Seq 1: run_rate_controller_main calls attitude_control->rate_controller_target_reset() (Attitude.cpp:23; attitude field cmd_attitude_rate_controller_target_reset). Seq 2: read_inertia, pos_control->update_estimates(vibration_check.high_vibes = false) (inertia.cpp:7). Seq 3: update_flight_mode, landed_gain_reduction(ap.land_complete = true, set in init_ardupilot) (mode.cpp:507). Seq 4: ModeStabilize::run: ap.throttle_zero is true without RC, so set_desired_spool_state(GROUND_IDLE) (mode_stabilize.cpp:20-21), a signal; AP_MotorsMulticopter::set_desired_spool_state stores SHUT_DOWN because the motors are disarmed (AP_MotorsMulticopter.cpp:574-577): spool_desired = 0. The mixer's spool_state is SHUT_DOWN (input 0), so mode_stabilize.cpp:29-34: seq 5 reset_yaw_target_and_rate(reset_rate = true, the default argument), seq 6 reset_rate_controller_I_terms(), pilot throttle 0. Seq 7: input_euler_angle_roll_pitch_euler_rate_yaw_rad(0, 0, 0): no RC, the pilot's lean angles and yaw rate are 0 (mode_stabilize.cpp:13-16, 57). Seq 8: set_throttle_out(0, true, g.throttle_filt = PILOT_THR_FILT default 0) (mode_stabilize.cpp:60). Tick 1 also has seq 9: update_home_from_EKF sets home from the EKF origin (commands.cpp:67, AP_AHRS::set_home): cmd_estimator_set_home(473977420, 85455940, 48800), the origin of the input record. Every call has a field: cmd_unmapped = 0 at both ticks. interlock = armed && ... = false (motors.cpp:94); likely_flying = false (land_complete true, Copter::set_land_complete -> set_likely_flying(!b), land_detector.cpp:229). No position or guidance command: STABILIZE does not run them. Checked against the executable: equal.
